coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 7 ground-truth variable items (43%): a fixed trigger threshold, the hierarchical versus non-hierarchical architecture comparison, and additional score metrics. Architecture matching is conceptual; the specified Mastaba and BaseLang agents are not used.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Adds mechanic ON/OFF as an independent variable rather than keeping built-in mechanics fixed. Does not specify score at invasion or trigger turn as measured outcomes. Measures survival from episode reset instead of additional turns after invasion. Replaces the named agents with synthetic fixed policies and omits most requested auxiliary metrics, including rewards, phase transitions, success rate, and training losses.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the anticipated chain of faster Mastaba score growth, earlier invasions, potentially shorter post-invasion survival, and strategic expansion benefits, as well as quantification of this trade-off using survival analysis and correlation statistics.
